audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] tells the player that if Singed Flings him, Last Breath is available 'off a knock-up'.
audit.why: Last Breath 'Blinks to an Airborne ENEMY champion'. Fling makes YOU airborne, not Singed, so the ult is unavailable in exactly the moment the page promises it. This is the most dangerous line in the entry.
audit.corrected: Fling flips you, not him — Last Breath does nothing off it. Make your own knockup with the Q2 tornado.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mega Adhesive's grounding and its Fling-root combo are never stated, and the one Wind Wall interaction in the matchup is denied outright.
audit.why: Mega Adhesive is a thrown vial (projectile flag) that grounds — grounding shuts off Sweeping Blade and Last Breath — and Riot's Fling text says a target flung into the adhesive is also rooted. Poison Trail is an aura and passes through Wind Wall untouched. The mirror audit records the same three facts.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall the Mega Adhesive vial (17s at rank 1); never spend it on the poison aura. If the goo is already down, do not dash across it — you are grounded, and a Fling into it roots you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ability slots are swapped: 'Fling (Q)' and 'Poison Trail (E)'.
audit.why: Poison Trail is Q, Mega Adhesive W, Fling E, Insanity Potion R.
audit.corrected: Slot letters corrected wherever they appear.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Yasuo no outright rows while the packet flags it as contradicting a 44.83% win rate.
audit.why: The already-audited singed side settled on Yasuo / Yasuo / Skill / Singed / Singed / Singed / Yasuo, which matches the kit reality: you win before Fling and Mega Adhesive are ranked, he owns the middle, you out-scale.
audit.corrected: Rows aligned in matched full/content pairs with ratings and rewritten whys.

audit.why: Fling 10s at rank 1 (125 range, targeted), Mega Adhesive 17s at rank 1, Insanity Potion a flat 100s, Poison Trail a toggle with no cooldown at 13 mana per tick.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into the spikes, mid and breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Level 3 you keep punishing him before his tankiness and Fling scaling arrive.
edits.after: At 3 his Fling is up every 10s and flips any greedy dive of yours.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 even out as Fling into poison/minions can flip greedy trades — pure skill.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 Mega Adhesive grounds your dashes and the Fling that follows roots you in it.

edits.before: Early you win the pure lane trade — E onto Singed and Q him while his only damage is Poison Trail (E) ticking under your feet. The danger is his Fling (Q): once he hits 3 he can Fling you into his poison and minions, so don't dive so deep that a single Fling flips the trade.
edits.after: Early you win the trade — E onto Singed and Q him while his only damage is Poison Trail (Q) ticking under you; it is an aura, so Wind Wall does nothing to it. The danger is Fling (E, 10s at rank 1) flipping you into the poison and his minions, so never dive deeper than one dash.

edits.before: At 6 you spike harder than he does — bait his Fling, and if he Flings you, R is off a knock-up he can't easily create otherwise, so your all-in threat is real. But respect Mega Adhesive (W) slow plus Fling comboing you into a gank; ward and don't chase him into fog.
edits.after: At 6 Insanity Potion (R, 100s) makes him tanky mid-fight, and Fling flips YOU airborne — Last Breath fires only on an airborne enemy, so it does nothing there. Wind Wall his Mega Adhesive (W, 17s) instead: it is a thrown vial, and without goo his root combo is gone.

edits.before: Skill-dependent late — Singed becomes a fling-and-run disruptor who dives your carries, and his sustain plus Fling can undo a sloppy Yasuo. Windwall nothing of his (he's mostly point-blank), so kite his poison, save E to disengage his Fling angle, and cluster fights so your DPS out-values his single-target dive.
edits.after: Skill-dependent late — Singed becomes a fling-and-run disruptor who dives your carries, and his sustain plus Fling can undo a sloppy Yasuo. Wind Wall the Mega Adhesive vial, the one projectile he owns, so the goo never grounds your E, and walk the poison aura off rather than trying to wall it.

edits.before: By levels 4-5 it evens to skill — his Fling into poison and minions can flip a greedy trade, so you must respect his combo and gank setups even while you hold a farm lead.
edits.after: By levels 4-5 he takes over — Mega Adhesive (17s at rank 1) grounds your E and R, and a Fling that lands you in the goo roots you there, so break the line before he throws it.

edits.before: Late is skill-dependent: Singed proxies, scales tanky, and dives your backline, so kite his poison, save E for his Fling angle, and win through teamfight positioning.
edits.after: Late you out-scale him: Singed proxies and dives, so wall the Mega Adhesive vial before it grounds your E, walk out of the poison aura, and win on teamfight positioning.

edits.before: Trade with E-Q while only his poison can answer
edits.after: Wind Wall his Mega Adhesive vial before it lands

edits.before: Fling (Q) you into poison, minions, or a waiting gank
edits.after: Fling (E) you into poison, minions, or a waiting gank

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Fling: 10s at rank 1 and targeted at 125 range — nothing blocks it, so stay out of melee. - Mega Adhesive: 17s at rank 1, a thrown vial Wind Wall blocks. - Insanity Potion: a flat 100s.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Landing in Mega Adhesive after a Fling roots you where you stand.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling: His flip. Dodge it. When it is down — EQ-R him.
edits.after: Wind Wall the Mega Adhesive vial; Poison Trail is an aura and ignores it.

notes: The mirror's notes flag that focus.text on the Singed side still reads 'Yasuo Poison Trail' with focus.letters ['Q']. On this side focus.text reads 'Singed Fling', which is a real Singed ability and correct — no change needed here, but the Singed-side focus fields still need the manual fix the mirror describes. Also worth knowing: Insanity Potion applies Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail, so his ult cuts your Bloodthirster/BotRK lifesteal — the entry never mentions it and the length band left no room in the level-6 spike to add it.
